CloudBackup.title: CloudBackup
CloudBackup.description: A user-saved snapshot of TV frame settings, selected photos, and cached calendar events stored in a user-defined Firestore collection.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner who created this backup.

ownerEmail.description: Verified email address of the backup owner.

settings.description: FrameSettings object containing display, slideshow, and overlay preferences.

photos.description: List of selected PhotoItem objects (up to 100 items).

events.description: List of synced CalendarEvent objects (up to 100 items).

photoCount.description: Number of photos in the backup.

eventCount.description: Number of calendar events in the backup.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the backup was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the backup was last updated.

TVDisplayState.title: TVDisplayState
TVDisplayState.description: Live published TV display state (non-PII display settings, calendar events, and ordered photo IDs) readable by the TV frame without requiring user login.

isPublicDisplay.description: Always true for the active TV display configuration.

settings.description: Public display settings (no PII or API keys).

events.description: Published upcoming calendar events (up to 100 items).

photoIds.description: Ordered list of published photo document IDs (up to 100 items).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last publish.

TVDisplayPhoto.title: TVDisplayPhoto
TVDisplayPhoto.description: Individual published photo stored in the TV display subcollection so photos load reliably without Google Drive login or exceeding 1MB doc limits.

isPublicDisplay.description: Always true for published display photos.

url.description: Image URL or portable JPEG data URL.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update.

/tv_backups/{backupId}.description: Default collection for storing TV fotolijst cloud backups; users may also target custom collection names with the same CloudBackup schema.

/tv_display/active.description: Published live TV display configuration (display settings and synced calendar events) readable without sign-in.

/tv_display/active/photos/{photoId}.description: Published TV display photos readable by the TV frame without sign-in.
